glm_product.description: GLM lightning flashes (time, lat/lon, area, energy, quality)

products.description: radar reflectivity (dBZ) at the -10 C isotherm, 0.01 deg, every 2 min; LightningCast v2's radar input; -999 outside radar coverage, -99 no echo

channels.name: cos_sza
channels.description: cosine of the solar zenith angle (helper)

channels.name: vis_064
channels.description: 0.64 um reflectance, divided by cos(solar zenith); missing when the sun is lower than ~84 deg

channels.name: nir_16
channels.description: 1.6 um reflectance (ice clouds are darker), divided by cos(solar zenith); missing when the sun is lower than ~84 deg

channels.name: c13_min
channels.description: coldest 2 km pixel in the cell (K): overshooting tops

channels.name: tpw
channels.description: total precipitable water (mm); clear sky only, so each cell keeps its last value for up to 60 min

channels.name: cape
channels.description: J/kg; clear sky only, last value kept up to 60 min

channels.name: lifted_index
channels.description: K; clear sky only, last value kept up to 60 min

channels.name: k_index
channels.description: K; clear sky only, last value kept up to 60 min

channels.name: fed
channels.description: flashes over each cell in the 5-min slot, each weighted by the share of the cell its GLM pixels cover (helper)

channels.name: fed_past_15min
channels.description: flash-extent density (glmtools' method, before rounding): flashes over the cell in the 15 min before the issue time, each weighted by the share of the cell its GLM pixels cover

labels.name: lightning_next_30min
labels.description: a flash footprint within 1 cell in the 30 min after the issue time

labels.name: lightning_next_60min
labels.description: a flash footprint within 1 cell in the 60 min after the issue time

labels.name: lightningcast_60min
labels.description: LightningCast's truth (Cintineo et al. 2022, Weather and Forecasting 37, 1239): a 1-minute flash-extent density of at least 1 flash in the 2 km pixel within 60 min of the scan's slot; for evaluation only

fields.name: elevation
fields.description: m, mean of NOAA ETOPO 2022 (1.85 km) over the cell; sea is 0, large lakes show their floor

fields.name: elevation_std
fields.description: terrain roughness (m): standard deviation of elevation within the cell

fields.name: land_fraction
fields.description: 1 land, 0 water (ocean and lakes), from NASA's 0.1 degree IMERG mask, interpolated

fields.name: satellite_zenith
fields.description: deg between the local vertical and the direction to GOES

fields.name: conus_land
fields.description: share of the cell on the contiguous US's land (Natural Earth 1:10m borders; the Great Lakes and other large lakes are water); for choosing where to score, not a model input

fields.name: conus_distance_km
fields.description: km from the cell centre to the nearest cell at least half on contiguous-US land (0 on it); for coastal bands

fields.name: any_land
fields.description: share of the cell on any country's land (Natural Earth 1:10m; large lakes are water)
